profile.headline: Solutions Architect / Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: 30+ years of Software Development using many different languages and open source technologies.

positions.title: Solutions Architect / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently working at Los Alamos National Laboratory writing Java 11 and 17 along with standard web technologies as a PTC ThingWorx architect and developer. Databases used are Oracle and MS SQL Server. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JQuery are also being written.  Also writing AI-Machine Learning models using Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, and Keras.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaScript · jQuery · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · SQL · PTC ThingWorx · Python (Programming Language) · C# · Machine Learning

positions.title: Solutions Architect, Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Alamos, New Mexico, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Worked at Los Alamos National Laboratory  writing Java 11 and 17 along with standard web technologies as a PTC ThingWorx architect and developer.  Databases used are Oracle and MS SQL Server.  HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JQuery are also being written.
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · PTC ThingWorx · Microsoft SQL Server · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · JavaScript · Java

positions.title: Senior Consultant - Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer at Sandia and Los Alamos National Laboratories.  Writing Java 1.8, 1.11 with MongoDB scripts along with web services using the Spring framework on the back-end.  JavaScript, ExtJS, and other standard web client markup/CSS are used/written on the front-end.  Also developing applications using Thingworx Internet of Things (IoT).

positions.title: Full Stack / Java Server Developer
positions.locationName: Aberdeen Proving Ground MD, Madison WI
positions.description: U.S Army Futures Command - Wrote RESTful web services using Java 1.8 and Clojure 1.10 for a Military contract (U.S. Army Futures Command). Worked with Berkeley DB as one of the databases. Grizzly and IIS were the web servers being used.  Bash shell scripting was also a responsibility.  Also worked in Microsoft Azure using Azure SQL Server, and the MongoDb API for Cosmos DB along with other miscellaneous Azure services.  This was a contract position.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on a data migration project writing SOAP and REST web services to communicate and exchange data between the two systems.  Java 1.8 and JBoss 7 were used as the primary language and application server.  Also worked on an email system conversion to Amazon SES, SNS, and S3 web services. 
Other responsibilities included writing Bash shell scripts for data manipulation and software deployments.  This was a contract position.

positions.title: Java Server Developer
positions.description: Wrote RESTful web services using Java 1.8 and Clojure 1.10.  The database is Berkeley DB Java Edition.  Grizzly is the web server being used.  Bash shell scripting was also a responsibility.

positions.title: President
positions.description: The primary focus of the company is software development and software development training.  The company also sub-contracts development services to other primary contractors in the Madison, WI area.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description: Wrote Java 1.8 programs to synchronize telecom data using JMS and Web Services (REST).  Wrote Bash Shell build/deploy scripts with Jenkins were also a responsibility.  Oracle 11 was the database that was used.  This was a contract position.

positions.title: Java Technical Lead
positions.description: Responsible for leading technical development efforts for major enterprise level projects for TEKSystem’s clients. Java and Enterprise level technologies (JBoss, SOAP/Rest Web Services, Oracle PL/SQL) are used. Also responsible for general Java and Open Source based software development on business applications. UNIX/Linux shell scripting (Bash/AWK) also a responsibility.   This was a contract position.

positions.title: Senior Software  Developer
positions.description: Developed software for WPS' Federal Medicare contract and the U.S. Military's Tricare health care system. Technologies included Websphere 8, Java (1.6, 1.7, 1.8) and Web Services (SOAP and Rest). Other miscellaneous development technologies used are writing complex DB2 queries, JMS, and CICS VSAM data exchanges.

positions.title: Faculty, School of Business
positions.description: Teaching business and IT concepts to business students.
